name: depgate
description: DepGate — Control what enters your software supply chain. Proxy, cache, and policy engine for npm, PyPI, Go, and Maven

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@depgate/backend && npm run lint --workspace=packages/ui
scripts.version: bash scripts/set-deploy-version.sh && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && git add deploy packages/backend/package.json packages/ui/package.json package-lock.json
